basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent college graduate with a degree in computer science, currently living in Austin, Texas. I've always been fascinated by technology and gadgets, which is why I often find myself browsing subreddits like laptops and 3D printing. My interests include playing indie video games, experimenting with DIY electronics, and learning about new software tools. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, as I currently work as a junior software developer. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring local cafes or attending tech meetups.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having just completed my degree in computer science, I have a foundational knowledge in programming and software development. Most of my technical know-how comes from coursework and personal projects, where I enjoy tinkering with new tech. I'm still learning and often turn to online communities for advice and troubleshooting tips.
